items.q: It was Lewis Hayes, myself, a piano player who was…Percy was finally playing

ctx.x: It was Lewis Hayes, myself, a piano player who was…Percy was finally playing, but then he had to leave. If I can think of his name, I can see him. He came to New York and he was the only one that wasn’t obsessive or…If you look at the Yusef Lateef’s website then he’s on there. He’s a very well dressed kid. We had a seminary profile.
So you guys went to Detroit just to record and then you decided--­
